objects.text: OLD MINE - closed after the collapse. Iron ore can still be found in the hills.
Here rest the founders of Brindle. The dead do not rest easy.
North: the Old Mine.   West: the forest track and the graveyard.   South: Brindle.
North: the Old Mine, the graveyard.   West: Mirror Lake.   East: Orc country - keep out!   South: the old farmstead and the quarry.
Beyond this point: ORCS. Turn back, friend.
South-west: the stone circle.   South: the old farmstead.   East: the quarry.
